newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas plumbs depths - no trade, no bid, no off.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas plumbs depths - no trade, no bid, no off.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures hit rock bottom at the end of a dismal week on Friday afternoon. Not only was no trade done but there was not a single bid, nor a single offer, in any period.

In the worst week since the contract started at the end of January, IPE natural gas has seen only four trades done totalling 55 lots. These were done in two separate sessions, so eight two-hour sessions have been untraded.
Prices have largely followed the physical market over the week, but at the close of trade on Friday afternoon there was no price indication at all.
